title: A Steady-State Kinetic Model for Methanol Synthesis and the Water Gas Shift Reaction on a Commercial Cu/ZnO/ $ Al_{2}O_{3} $ Catalyst

model_assumptions.text: CO₂ is the main source of carbon in methanol.
model_assumptions.quote: Based on the results of Chinchen et al. (14) and Rozovskii (15), we assume that  $ CO_{2} $ is the main source of carbon in methanol.

model_assumptions.text: The concentrations of the different surface intermediates are in pseudo-steady state.
model_assumptions.quote: Derivation of the corresponding set of kinetic equations is performed under the hypothesis of pseudo-steady-state of the concentration of the different surface intermediates (13).
